PLCMT_MARS_ARIES.core: Your Mars in Aries, its home sign, means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is at maximum directness and speed. You act immediately. You fight cleanly. Mars is your drive, anger, and physical energy, and in Aries it operates at full strength—decisive, courageous, direct. Your assertion doesn't wait for perfect conditions. It fires. Your anger is hot and immediate but doesn't hold grudges. Your energy comes from having something to pursue, from challenges that require courage, from the freedom to act without deliberation. You compete instinctively. Hesitation feels like death to your Mars. The challenge is recognizing that not every situation benefits from immediate action, that some conflicts need strategy rather than just force.
PLCMT_MARS_ARIES.behavioral: You act fast, fight directly, and compete naturally. When you want something, you go after it now. When you're angry, you express it immediately and move on. Your assertion is physical and honest. You don't hold back or strategize endlessly. This isn't recklessness. It's genuine courage. You trust your first instinct. The shadow is that speed can override accuracy. You may act before you have enough information, or you may start fights you didn't need to start because immediate response felt necessary. The work is creating enough pause between impulse and action that your assertion serves your actual goals rather than just satisfying the need to move.
PLCMT_MARS_ARIES.feed: Mars is moving through Aries, its home sign, in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and physical energy are at maximum strength and directness right now. This is a time for immediate action, for competing honestly, for trusting your courage.
PLCMT_MARS_ARIES.sonic: Your Mars in Aries contributes sharp rhythmic attacks, aggressive harmonic drive, and melody that is forceful and direct. The quality of assertion is immediate and physical, creating energy through bold action. Listen for music where the drive is undeniable and the attack is clean and strong.

PLCMT_MARS_TAURUS.core: Your Mars in Taurus means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around patience, endurance, and building slowly. You act deliberately. You fight by outlasting. Mars is your drive and physical energy, and in Taurus it operates through sustained effort and refusal to be rushed. Your assertion doesn't waste energy on speed. It builds steadily. Your anger is slow to ignite but hard to extinguish. Your energy comes from working with your hands, from projects that require sustained effort, from the satisfaction of building something that lasts. You endure rather than sprint. Rushing feels wasteful to your Mars. The challenge is recognizing when patience has become stubbornness, when refusing to quit is keeping you in situations that no longer serve you.
PLCMT_MARS_TAURUS.behavioral: You act methodically, fight by refusing to yield, and work with steady endurance. When you want something, you pursue it patiently over time. When you're angry, you don't explode—you hold it and it doesn't fade easily. Your assertion is physical and grounded. You work steadily without needing constant excitement. This isn't slowness. It's genuine staying power. The shadow is that endurance can become rigidity. You may keep pushing long after the goal has ceased to be worth the effort, or you may refuse to change direction because you've already invested so much. The work is honoring your capacity for sustained effort while remaining willing to quit when quitting is actually the right choice.
PLCMT_MARS_TAURUS.feed: Mars is moving through Taurus in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and physical energy are focused on patience, endurance, and building steadily right now. This is a time for sustained effort, for working with your hands, for trusting that real achievement takes time.
PLCMT_MARS_TAURUS.sonic: Your Mars in Taurus contributes steady rhythmic pulse, grounded harmonic weight, and melody that builds through accumulation. The quality of assertion is patient and enduring, creating energy through sustained pressure. Listen for music where the drive is relentless but unhurried, building through time rather than speed.

PLCMT_MARS_GEMINI.core: Your Mars in Gemini means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around mental agility, variety, and keeping multiple options active. You act through thinking. You fight with words. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Gemini it operates through mental quickness and the capacity to pursue several things simultaneously. Your assertion doesn't commit to single tracks. It explores multiple paths. Your anger is expressed verbally and doesn't stay focused on one grievance. Your energy comes from mental stimulation, from having several projects running at once, from the freedom to shift between interests. You multitask naturally. Boredom feels intolerable to your Mars. The challenge is developing enough focus that your agility becomes mastery rather than just scattered effort.
PLCMT_MARS_GEMINI.behavioral: You act through conversation, fight with arguments, and need mental variety to stay energized. When you want something, you research it, talk about it, approach it from multiple angles. When you're angry, you argue your case verbally. Your assertion is intellectual and adaptable. You don't push through with brute force—you think around obstacles. This isn't weakness. It's mental agility applied to action. The shadow is that variety can prevent completion. You may start many things without finishing any, or you may use verbal sparring to avoid physical confrontation. The work is allowing yourself to focus long enough that one of your many interests becomes expertise.
PLCMT_MARS_GEMINI.feed: Mars is moving through Gemini in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on mental agility, variety, and pursuing multiple interests right now. This is a time for thinking your way through challenges, for keeping several projects active, for trusting your mental quickness.
PLCMT_MARS_GEMINI.sonic: Your Mars in Gemini contributes quick rhythmic changes, nimble harmonic movement, and melody that is articulate and varied. The quality of assertion is mental and adaptable, creating energy through intellectual agility. Listen for music where the drive comes from quick thinking and the capacity to shift directions easily.

PLCMT_MARS_CANCER.core: Your Mars in Cancer means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around protection, emotional motivation, and defending what matters. You act when emotionally moved. You fight to protect. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Cancer it operates through emotional instinct and the need to defend home and family. Your assertion doesn't respond to logic—it responds to feeling. Your anger is tied to emotional wounds and protective instinct. Your energy comes from caring for what you love, from creating emotional safety, from defending against threats to your security. You fight for others more easily than for yourself. Emotional safety feels necessary to your Mars. The challenge is recognizing when protection has become defensiveness that prevents necessary risk.
PLCMT_MARS_CANCER.behavioral: You act when emotionally motivated, fight to protect loved ones, and need emotional security to assert yourself. When you want something, you have to feel it's right emotionally. When you're angry, it's usually because someone hurt you or someone you care about. Your assertion is emotionally driven and protective. You don't fight for abstract principles—you fight for people and places that matter. This isn't weakness. It's genuine emotional courage. The shadow is that protection can become retreat. You may avoid assertion that requires emotional risk, or you may stay defensive even when attack isn't coming. The work is honoring your emotional instincts while remaining willing to act even when emotional safety isn't guaranteed.
PLCMT_MARS_CANCER.feed: Mars is moving through Cancer in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on protection, emotional motivation, and defending what you love right now. This is a time for fighting for people who matter, for trusting your emotional instincts, for creating safety through active protection.
PLCMT_MARS_CANCER.sonic: Your Mars in Cancer contributes flowing rhythmic patterns, emotionally charged harmonic movement, and melody that is protective and responsive. The quality of assertion is emotional and defensive, creating energy through care and protection. Listen for music where the drive comes from feeling and the need to defend what's loved.

PLCMT_MARS_LEO.core: Your Mars in Leo means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around pride, creative expression, and being seen doing it. You act boldly. You fight with dignity. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Leo it operates through confident self-expression and the need to pursue goals that reflect who you are. Your assertion doesn't hide. It performs. Your anger is dramatic and tied to wounded pride. Your energy comes from creative projects, from challenges where you can shine, from the freedom to express yourself fully. You compete with style. Invisibility feels like defeat to your Mars. The challenge is distinguishing between assertion that serves genuine goals and performance that's just serving the need to be seen.
PLCMT_MARS_LEO.behavioral: You act with confidence, fight with pride, and need recognition for your efforts. When you want something, you pursue it visibly and with style. When you're angry, you express it dramatically. Your assertion is theatrical and generous. You don't compete quietly—you want your efforts to be witnessed and appreciated. This isn't vanity. It's genuine pride in your work. The shadow is that visibility can become the goal. You may perform assertion without actually having conviction, or you may need applause for every effort. The work is ensuring that what you're pursuing actually matters to you, not just to the audience you're trying to impress.
PLCMT_MARS_LEO.feed: Mars is moving through Leo in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on bold self-expression, creative action, and being seen right now. This is a time for pursuing goals with confidence, for fighting with dignity, for trusting that your efforts deserve recognition.
PLCMT_MARS_LEO.sonic: Your Mars in Leo contributes confident rhythmic presence, warm harmonic boldness, and melody that is expressive and commanding. The quality of assertion is theatrical and generous, creating energy through visible excellence. Listen for music where the drive is expressed with pride and style.

PLCMT_MARS_VIRGO.core: Your Mars in Virgo means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around precision, useful work, and doing things correctly. You act methodically. You fight by finding flaws. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Virgo it operates through careful analysis and the satisfaction of skilled execution. Your assertion doesn't rush. It refines. Your anger is expressed through criticism and the frustration of things being done poorly. Your energy comes from useful work, from projects that require skill, from the pleasure of doing something well. You compete through competence. Sloppiness feels intolerable to your Mars. The challenge is recognizing that perfection can prevent action, that waiting for perfect conditions means never starting.
PLCMT_MARS_VIRGO.behavioral: You act precisely, fight by pointing out errors, and need your efforts to be competent and useful. When you want something, you plan carefully and execute skillfully. When you're angry, you criticize what's not working. Your assertion is analytical and exacting. You don't charge forward blindly—you fix what's broken and improve what's working. This isn't passivity. It's genuine skill applied to action. The shadow is that precision can become paralysis. You may analyze so thoroughly that you never act, or you may criticize when you're trying to help. The work is allowing yourself to act even when conditions aren't perfect, to pursue goals before every detail is optimized.
PLCMT_MARS_VIRGO.feed: Mars is moving through Virgo in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on precision, useful work, and skilled execution right now. This is a time for careful action, for refining your efforts, for competing through demonstrated competence.
PLCMT_MARS_VIRGO.sonic: Your Mars in Virgo contributes precise rhythmic execution, clean harmonic voice leading, and melody that is detailed and exact. The quality of assertion is skillful and refined, creating energy through competence. Listen for music where the drive comes from doing things correctly and with care.

PLCMT_MARS_LIBRA.core: Your Mars in Libra means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around fairness, diplomacy, and avoiding unnecessary conflict. You act through negotiation. You fight for justice. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Libra it operates through balanced consideration and the need to pursue goals that feel fair to everyone involved. Your assertion doesn't steamroll. It persuades. Your anger is triggered by unfairness and expressed through measured response. Your energy comes from projects you pursue with partners, from challenges that require collaboration, from the satisfaction of achieving balance. You compete gracefully. Brutality feels wrong to your Mars. The challenge is acting decisively when perfect fairness isn't achievable, when choosing means someone doesn't get what they want.
PLCMT_MARS_LIBRA.behavioral: You act diplomatically, fight for fairness, and need your assertion to be balanced and graceful. When you want something, you consider how it affects everyone. When you're angry, you try to resolve it fairly. Your assertion is measured and relational. You don't force your way—you negotiate toward solutions that work for all sides. This isn't weakness. It's genuine commitment to fair action. The shadow is that balance can prevent necessary action. You may weigh options endlessly without choosing, or you may suppress legitimate anger to maintain peace. The work is allowing yourself to act even when action disrupts harmony, to fight when fighting is actually fair.
PLCMT_MARS_LIBRA.feed: Mars is moving through Libra in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on fairness, diplomacy, and balanced action right now. This is a time for negotiating rather than forcing, for competing gracefully, for pursuing goals that honor all parties.
PLCMT_MARS_LIBRA.sonic: Your Mars in Libra contributes balanced rhythmic interplay, graceful harmonic progressions, and melody that is diplomatic and elegant. The quality of assertion is measured and fair, creating energy through collaboration. Listen for music where the drive comes from partnership and the pursuit of justice.

PLCMT_MARS_SCORPIO.core: Your Mars in Scorpio, its traditional home, means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is at maximum intensity and strategic power. You act with complete focus. You fight to win totally. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Scorpio it operates at peak capacity for sustained pressure, psychological insight, and refusal to surrender. Your assertion doesn't show all its cards. It strategizes. Your anger is cold, controlled, and doesn't forget. Your energy comes from challenges that require sustained effort, from pursuing goals that transform you, from the satisfaction of complete victory. You compete to dominate. Half-measures feel pointless to your Mars. The challenge is recognizing when total commitment is serving genuine goals versus just satisfying your need for intensity.
PLCMT_MARS_SCORPIO.behavioral: You act strategically, fight to win completely, and pursue goals with obsessive focus. When you want something, you commit totally and won't quit until you have it. When you're angry, you don't explode—you plan and execute revenge. Your assertion is intense and controlled. You don't waste energy on surface conflicts—you go for psychological victory. This isn't cruelty. It's genuine power wielded consciously. The shadow is that intensity can become destruction. You may pursue victory past the point where winning serves any purpose, or you may use power to dominate when collaboration would work better. The work is ensuring that your formidable drive serves goals that actually deserve that level of commitment.
PLCMT_MARS_SCORPIO.feed: Mars is moving through Scorpio, its traditional home, in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are at maximum intensity and strategic power right now. This is a time for total commitment, for pursuing goals with focused obsession, for wielding power consciously.
PLCMT_MARS_SCORPIO.sonic: Your Mars in Scorpio contributes relentless rhythmic pressure, dark harmonic intensity, and melody that is chromatic and penetrating. The quality of assertion is strategic and total, creating energy through sustained power. Listen for music where the drive is inexorable and the force is concentrated and controlled.

PLCMT_MARS_SAGITTARIUS.core: Your Mars in Sagittarius means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around enthusiasm, expansion, and aiming high. You act optimistically. You fight for principles. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Sagittarius it operates through forward momentum and the willingness to take risks for big goals. Your assertion doesn't calculate odds carefully. It aims and shoots. Your anger is expressed through blunt honesty and moral outrage. Your energy comes from adventures, from goals that expand your world, from the freedom to pursue what seems impossible. You compete with optimism. Caution feels limiting to your Mars. The challenge is grounding your enthusiasm in reality, ensuring that optimism serves achievable goals rather than just keeping you moving without direction.
PLCMT_MARS_SAGITTARIUS.behavioral: You act boldly, fight for what you believe, and pursue goals that feel meaningful and expansive. When you want something, you aim high and trust you'll figure it out on the way. When you're angry, you say exactly what you think. Your assertion is enthusiastic and direct. You don't hedge your bets—you commit fully and trust the outcome. This isn't naivete. It's genuine courage to reach beyond current capacity. The shadow is that optimism can ignore real obstacles. You may overcommit because everything seems possible, or you may use enthusiasm to avoid practical planning. The work is honoring your vision while building the foundation that makes achievement actually sustainable.
PLCMT_MARS_SAGITTARIUS.feed: Mars is moving through Sagittarius in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on enthusiasm, expansion, and aiming for meaningful goals right now. This is a time for bold action, for fighting for principles, for trusting your optimism.
PLCMT_MARS_SAGITTARIUS.sonic: Your Mars in Sagittarius contributes energetic rhythmic drive, expansive harmonic progressions, and melody that is bold and ascending. The quality of assertion is optimistic and far-reaching, creating energy through adventurous pursuit. Listen for music where the drive comes from enthusiasm and the willingness to aim beyond current limits.

PLCMT_MARS_CAPRICORN.core: Your Mars in Capricorn, its exalted position, means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is at maximum discipline and strategic achievement. You act patiently. You fight by outlasting and outmaneuvering. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Capricorn it operates at peak capacity for sustained effort, strategic planning, and the willingness to work as long as necessary. Your assertion doesn't waste energy. It builds systematically toward goals. Your anger is cold and controlled. Your energy comes from long-term projects, from challenges that require endurance, from the satisfaction of earned success. You compete through superior discipline. Shortcuts feel dishonorable to your Mars. The challenge is allowing yourself to enjoy the process, not just the achievement.
PLCMT_MARS_CAPRICORN.behavioral: You act strategically, fight with discipline, and pursue goals with patient determination. When you want something, you build toward it systematically over years. When you're angry, you don't let it show—you use it as fuel. Your assertion is controlled and ambitious. You don't waste energy on immediate gratification—you invest it in long-term achievement. This isn't joylessness. It's genuine respect for mastery. The shadow is that discipline can become all-consuming. You may sacrifice everything for achievement, or you may judge yourself harshly for any deviation from the plan. The work is honoring your capacity for sustained effort while allowing pleasure that doesn't serve productive goals.
PLCMT_MARS_CAPRICORN.feed: Mars is moving through Capricorn, its exalted position, in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are at maximum discipline and strategic power right now. This is a time for patient achievement, for building systematically, for competing through superior endurance.
PLCMT_MARS_CAPRICORN.sonic: Your Mars in Capricorn contributes steady rhythmic discipline, structured harmonic progressions, and melody that builds through systematic development. The quality of assertion is strategic and enduring, creating energy through controlled ambition. Listen for music where the drive comes from discipline and the satisfaction of earned mastery.

PLCMT_MARS_AQUARIUS.core: Your Mars in Aquarius means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around innovation, independence, and working toward collective good. You act unconventionally. You fight for principles and systems change. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Aquarius it operates through intellectual independence and the willingness to rebel against what's not working. Your assertion doesn't follow conventional paths. It innovates. Your anger is triggered by injustice to groups or violation of principles. Your energy comes from projects that serve collective good, from challenges that require original thinking, from the freedom to pursue goals your own way. You compete by being different. Conformity feels deadening to your Mars. The challenge is ensuring that rebellion serves actual improvement rather than just satisfying your need to be different.
PLCMT_MARS_AQUARIUS.behavioral: You act independently, fight for groups and principles, and pursue goals that challenge conventional approaches. When you want something, you find unconventional ways to achieve it. When you're angry, it's usually about systemic unfairness. Your assertion is detached and innovative. You don't force through with emotion—you outthink the opposition. This isn't coldness. It's intellectual courage applied to action. The shadow is that independence can become isolation. You may reject good conventional approaches just because they're conventional, or you may use innovation to avoid the hard work of implementation. The work is ensuring that your unconventional methods actually serve the goals rather than just proving you're original.
PLCMT_MARS_AQUARIUS.feed: Mars is moving through Aquarius in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on innovation, independence, and collective contribution right now. This is a time for unconventional action, for fighting for principles, for pursuing goals that serve the whole.
PLCMT_MARS_AQUARIUS.sonic: Your Mars in Aquarius contributes irregular rhythmic patterns, unexpected harmonic progressions, and melody that is innovative and detached. The quality of assertion is intellectual and unconventional, creating energy through original thinking. Listen for music where the drive comes from rebellion and the pursuit of systemic improvement.

PLCMT_MARS_PISCES.core: Your Mars in Pisces means how you assert yourself and pursue what you want is organized around compassion, imagination, and surrendering to larger currents. You act intuitively. You fight by not fighting. Mars is your drive and assertion, and in Pisces it operates through going with the flow and achieving goals through indirect means. Your assertion doesn't force. It adapts. Your anger is absorbed and expressed indirectly or turned inward. Your energy comes from creative work, from spiritual practice, from serving without needing recognition. You compete compassionately, if at all. Aggression feels cruel to your Mars. The challenge is developing enough assertion that compassion doesn't become self-sacrifice, that going with flow doesn't mean having no direction.
PLCMT_MARS_PISCES.behavioral: You act intuitively, fight indirectly or not at all, and pursue goals through adaptation rather than force. When you want something, you feel your way toward it rather than charging directly. When you're angry, you may not express it—you absorb it or channel it into art. Your assertion is fluid and compassionate. You don't compete aggressively—you flow around obstacles. This isn't weakness. It's genuine understanding that force isn't the only form of power. The shadow is that fluidity can become passivity. You may avoid necessary assertion because it feels too aggressive, or you may sacrifice your own needs entirely to serve others. The work is developing enough boundary that compassion includes self-care, that flowing includes direction.
PLCMT_MARS_PISCES.feed: Mars is moving through Pisces in your chart. Your drive, assertion, and energy are focused on intuition, compassion, and flowing with larger currents right now. This is a time for indirect action, for achieving through adaptation, for trusting that surrender itself is a form of strength.
PLCMT_MARS_PISCES.sonic: Your Mars in Pisces contributes fluid rhythmic ambiguity, dissolving harmonic boundaries, and melody that is indirect and adaptive. The quality of assertion is compassionate and intuitive, creating energy through surrender. Listen for music where the drive comes from flowing with rather than against, where power is found in yielding rather than forcing.
